decisions.notes: Rejected as a semantic near-duplicate of existing Cambridge Belfry and four-star accommodation dialogues (including dlg.multiwoz.pmul3692.json, dlg.multiwoz.pmul3963.json, and dlg.multiwoz.pmul4309.json); the candidate adds no distinct hotel fact.

Rejected as a semantic near-duplicate of already reviewed Lensfield Hotel content (including dlg.multiwoz.sng01193.json, dlg.multiwoz.pmul1718.json, and dlg.multiwoz.sng0839.json); the weak booking closure does not add enough distinct learner-facing coverage.

Rejected as a semantic near-duplicate of existing Lovell Lodge and Soul Tree Nightclub coverage. In particular, dlg.multiwoz.sng1061.json already covers Soul Tree's £4 entrance fee with richer address and postcode details.

Rejected as a semantic near-duplicate of existing Warkworth House and east-side four-star guesthouse content (including dlg.multiwoz.sng0853.json and dlg.multiwoz.sng0793.json); the Warkworth Terrace recommendation is already covered.

Rejected for learner-facing incompleteness: the dialogue recommends Autumn House but ends by asking for a booking day before the learner answers. Autumn House is also already covered in existing reviewed content.
